violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Air Gap Provided
violations.observation: Observed the pre-wash spray hose to extend below the flood rim level of the sink basin at the secondary 3-vat sink
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by providing an air gap as specified under 5-202.13. The spray hose at the 3-vat sink shall be altered to hang above the flood level rim of the 3-vat sink in order to provide an air gap. PIC HUNG UP PRE-SCRAPE HOSE DURING INSPECTION. PIC UNDERSTANDS HOSE SHOULD BE SHORTENED OR A LONGER SPRING SHOULD BE INSTALLED AS SOON AS POSSIBLE TO SERVE AS A PERMANENT FIX.

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: OBSERVED EMPLOYEES ACTIVELY USING HIGH TEMPERATURE DISHWASHING MACHINE, WHICH MET A MAXIMUM TEMPERATURE OF 153.6F DURING INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. PIC SET-UP THREE COMPARTMENT SINK AND SANITIZED EQUIPMENT IN THREE-VAT SINK DURING INSPECTION. PIC WILL ENSURE DISHWASHING MACHINE IS NOT USED TO SANITIZE DISH- WARE UNTIL IT HAS BEEN REPAIRED AND CAN MEET 160F AT A MINIMUM.
